label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Influencer Marketing
body: Working with people who have an audience to share your products or services with their followers, often for a fee or free products.
caption:
You might partner with someone whose followers align with your ideal customers. This could mean sending a creator your new digital planner to review, or offering a small commission if they mention your handmade jewelry shop. It's about reaching new eyes through trusted voices in a way that feels natural. Consider who in your niche genuinely loves what you do. 🤔
